name: caller-principal-require-class-admits-an-unbound-session
description: R16 -- version skew, the direction this coordinator can observe. A client that predates the principal never claims, so the session it names is UNBOUND: its require-class commit is admitted on BOTH backends, exactly as before the principal existed. Refusing it would not surface anywhere -- the shipped hook client turns any non-2xx into {}, an allow -- so the write would go silently unrecorded. The same request naming a CLAIMED session is refused on Python (fixture 07).
